Image 2: Provider Logo Large Language Models as Mental Health Resources: Patterns of Use in the United States ======================================================================================. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly accessible, there has been a rise of anecdotal evidence suggesting that users may be increasingly turning to LLMs for mental health support. This study aims to assess the frequency, motivations, and perceived effectiveness of LLM use for mental health support or therapy-related goals among U.S. residents with ongoing mental health conditions who have used LLMs in the past year. ### Publication Citation.
